labs.title: Get a feel for it.
labs.lede: Three safe, self-contained widgets. Nothing here touches a real host or sends anything off your device.

firewall.title: Firewall policy sandbox
firewall.intro: Write first-match allow/deny rules against a fixed set of sample packets. An implicit default-deny catches anything no rule matches, just like a real packet filter. Aim to permit only what should be reachable.
firewall.exposedHint: A policy that allows something a careful default-deny would block.

packets.ssh: Inbound remote shell (SSH) from the internet

fer.title: Confidence threshold explorer
fer.intro: A fixed example output from a facial-emotion model over the seven standard classes. Drag the threshold: below it the system abstains instead of guessing. This is the cost-sensitive trade-off the research is about.
fer.liveNote: Camera frames are processed on your device only and never leave the browser.

headers.title: Audit this site's response headers
headers.intro: A live check of the very page you're reading. It fetches /api/status and the response headers, and grades the security posture. Every claim on this site is meant to be checkable.
headers.note: No secrets are exposed — only whether each protection is switched on.

certs.title: Earned, and in progress.
certs.lede: What's verified is shown as a credential. What's a goal is labelled as one. No badge here claims something that isn't held.
certs.goalNote: These are stated targets, not credentials held. They're listed to show direction, never to imply certification.
